title: autoscoped diagnostic walker and oncall evidence bundle
author: Ava Martinez
description: Adds a new 'diagnostic walker' feature that automatically runs a scoped series of safe telemetry probes and assembles an evidence bundle for on-call handoff. Motivation: reduce time-to-first-action during incidents by providing a bounded, auditable diagnostic sweep that collects traces, logs, and lightweight health checks without granting broad runbook privileges. Key behavior: 1) user triggers a walker with an incident id; 2) walker consults a per-service probe catalog and a safety policy to select non-invasive probes; 3) probes run in sandboxed worker pods with time/IO caps; 4) results are deduplicated, scored, and packaged into a compressed evidence bundle with a short human summary and machine-readable diagnostics for playbook tools. Checklist: - [x] probe catalog schema and examples - [x] worker sandbox and timeout enforcement - [x] evidence bundle serializer + checksum - [x] on-call summary generator with templated hints - [x] CLI command and HTTP endpoint w/ RBAC checks - [x] unit + integration tests with CI profiles - [x] docs and runbook snippets. Security notes: probes are constrained (no write shell access, network egress restricted to telemetry ingest), and all collected data is marked for retention policy enforcement. This change is intentionally conservative: default probe sets are small and require an incident-scoped opt-in. Related linear: ENG-7480, ENG-7599.

review_comments: Rohit Gupta: Nice design. Two asks: (1) make retention tag explicit in the bundle metadata so downstream archival can act, (2) add a canned failure-mode explanation if sandbox kills a probe due to cgroup oom. Can you add short tests for both?
Author (Ava Martinez): Added retention tag and expanded serializer tests; included a human-friendly 'probe killed' note in the summary. See commit f114ab7.
Claire Liu: CI flake on e2e initially (timing); recommend making the integration test use a test double for external telemetry ingestion to avoid network flakiness.
Author (Ava Martinez): Reworked e2e to use local stub ingestion and added retry/backoff. CI green on rerun.
Marco Santos: Can we limit which teams can run the walker via RBAC? Please ensure handler checks for incident-scoped grant and update docs.
Author (Ava Martinez): Enforced incident-scoped RBAC in walker_handler and documented the policy.
release_notes: Introduce diagnostic walker: a safe, scoped probe runner and evidence bundler to speed incident triage. Disabled by default; requires opt-in per team and incident RBAC.
merge_outcome: Merged after 3 approvals and CI green. Disabled-by-default feature flag respected; docs added to runbooks/diagnostic-walker.md and examples updated.
